title: content_search broad-but-plausible queries can spill oversized dumps without enough narrowing guidance
wanted_capability: For broad repository searches, content_search should provide a compact top-results response with clear truncation/refinement guidance before writing a large harness dump. It should make it obvious when the query matched too broadly, suggest narrower path/glob/pattern options, and avoid making a normal exploratory search feel like an output explosion.
missing_primitive: progressive disclosure and refinement hints for broad content_search results
fallback_used: Switched from broad content_search to glob + smart_read + code.items + bounded file_read once the broad result proved noisy.
notes: The agent made one genuine path mistake by searching src before crates/bro-cli, but subsequent broad searches were plausible during code orientation. The tool's dump behavior amplified those exploratory searches instead of nudging toward structured/bounded reads like smart_read or code.items.
